tag.name: qr
tag.description: QR codes from text, as JSON (PNG as base64 and a data: URI), SVG, or a self-contained HTML page. Pure computation, no storage.

get.summary: Encode text as a QR code (JSON, SVG or HTML page)
get.description: One action, three outputs chosen by format. * json (default) - the PNG as base64 in png, the same as a ready-to-use data: URI in dataUri, and the metadata: text, bytes, ecc, version, modules, mask, scale, border, pixels, pngBytes. This is the form for scripts: one base64 decode gives the image bytes. * svg - image/svg+xml. Text rather than binary, so it works directly as the target of an , is resolution-independent, and is drawn as a single path with horizontal runs merged, so it stays compact. * html - a self-contained page with the PNG inlined, the text it encodes, version, module count, error-correction level, a download link, and a small form that re-encodes new text (submitting back to qr/get with format=html, keeping ecc/scale/border). Errors in this format are an HTML page too. Byte-mode encoding, all 40 versions, all four error-correction levels, automatic mask selection; the smallest version that fits is chosen unless version forces a larger one.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to encode, URL-encoded. Up to 2900 bytes of UTF-8, and fewer at higher error-correction levels. Send text or text64, not both.

parameters.name: text64
parameters.description: Base64 of the text (standard or URL-safe alphabet, padding optional). Use this for anything containing + & % or #, which do not survive a query string intact.

parameters.name: ecc
parameters.description: Error-correction level, case-insensitive: L recovers about 7% damage, M about 15%, Q about 25%, H about 30%. Higher levels cost capacity, so a long payload at H may need a larger symbol or be rejected.

parameters.name: border
parameters.description: Quiet zone in modules, 0-16 (clamped). Default 4, which the specification calls for; less can stop some readers finding the symbol.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Minimum symbol version, 1-40 (clamped). Default 1 = smallest that fits. Useful when a fixed physical size matters more than density.

200.description: JSON (default), SVG or HTML according to format
